summary: All 23 SRanger requirements implemented across 8 Java files under src/main/java/sranger/. Five points flagged for review.

issues.title: Move(lv, av) modelled as a two-argument actuator call, not an OutputEvent record
issues.raw: RoboChart events carry a single payload; a two-real output must be a multi-arg call, which becomes a RoboChart Call in LOperations.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm that actuator.move(lv, av) is the intended encoding of SR-DM4, or accept losing av if an OutputEvent record is required.

issues.title: FINAL carries a tick self-loop that no SR-Beh requirement specifies
issues.raw: A mode with no outgoing transition is a deadlock in the extracted Z-machine; java_codegen_rules.txt requires a tick-triggered self-loop on terminal modes.
issues.fix_directive: Accept the extra transition or provide a requirement for it. SR-DC1 is not violated (no duplicate source/trigger pair).

issues.title: Branch priority inside Turning is unspecified
issues.raw: SR-Beh5/6/7 give no relative priority. Resolved as endTask > turnDurationElapsed > tick.
issues.fix_directive: The autonomous transition must precede the tick self-loop or the per-cycle tick starves it. Confirm endTask outranks both.

issues.title: Clock exposes seconds rather than milliseconds
issues.raw: Clock.nowSeconds() returns seconds so clockResetTime and TURN_DURATION share the spec's unit.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm seconds is acceptable; otherwise add a millisecond constant.

issues.title: Sensor missing-data default is 1000.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 says 'a large default value' without fixing one.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm 1000.0 m or specify the intended default.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
